info.name: Volimox API and integration contracts
info.description: Repository-owned smoke and negative contracts for Volimox's demo, readiness, and Proton bridge boundaries. Values are placeholders; never commit real secrets.

exec: pm.test('readiness reports a deterministic state', () => pm.expect([200, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('demo quote returns a controlled API response', () => pm.expect([200, 400, 429, 502]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('invalid lead payload is rejected', () => pm.expect([400, 429]).to.include(pm.response.code));

body.raw:
{
  "pickup_address": "1 Main Street, New York, NY",
  "destination_address": "JFK Airport",
  "departure_time_iso": "2030-01-01T12:00:00Z",
  "passenger_count": 1,
  "luggage_count": 0
}

exec: pm.test('Proton bridge returns a controlled API response', () => pm.expect([200, 400, 429, 502]).to.include(pm.response.code));
